description: An escalation record emitted when a worker's matter needs NEGOTIATION and therefore CANNOT be handled by kadode as a 使者 (per ADR-2606112238). This is the structural expression of the G1 / 弁護士法72条 boundary: when the goal is not a pure unilateral resignation but a negotiation (未払い賃金請求 / 退職条件 / 示談 / 損害賠償への対応), kadode REFUSES to relay and routes the worker to a labour union (団体交渉権, 労働組合法6) or a lawyer (法律事務). kadode never negotiates; it hands off. This record is the honest, on-log proof that the boundary was respected.

relayed.description: MUST be false — kadode did NOT relay this matter (it needs negotiation, G1).

escalateTo.description: kadode route id the worker is referred to (`r.union` / `r.lawyer`).

escalateActor.description: WHO can lawfully handle the negotiation — a labour union (団体交渉) or a lawyer.

reason.description: Plain-language reason for the escalation (negotiation is out of kadode's 使者 scope).
